Interface IPositionedItem

All Superinterfaces:
IAttachable, IIdentifiable, IMetadataContainer, INamed, IPropertiesContainer, com.tractrac.util.lib.api.serialize.ISerializable
public interface IPositionedItem extends INamed, com.tractrac.util.lib.api.serialize.ISerializable, IMetadataContainer

It represents a item with an attached position, either from a tracker or a static location. These objects are not drawn in the viewer; they are simply "a concept of an object that has a position on the map."

      boolean isStatic()

    • getPositions

      List<ISimplePosition> getPositions()
      Only if the positioned item is static, this method returns the static positions attached to this object. On this first version this method returns only one single object but in the future this method can return two or more positions.
      Returns:
      a list of static positions
